narrative.northStar: The Route Map From Your Own Campus
narrative.overview:
The home is drawn like a Taipei metro diagram. The student's school is the origin station, each region of the world is a coloured line, each partner country is a station, and the state of a station is drawn rather than implied. One white ground, one near-black ink, five saturated line colours; no gradients, glass or blur. Depth is 2px ink outlines, flat fills and rules.

The --mt-* properties in metro.css are the source of truth; legacy --uw-* and --glass-* names are remapped onto them so older stylesheets inherit the world. A light day service and a night variant are selected by html[data-theme].

Only the home was designed as a surface; other routes inherit through tokens plus override blocks.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, ink #1a1d23, five region line colours, no gradients, glass or blur.
Station-board controls: black bars with a 6px line-coloured top rule per cell and one orange action.
Heavy gothic (weight 800-900) for every name and heading, in Noto Sans TC self-hosted as UniWay Sign.
Ruled 2px ink outlines for containers; flat, no resting shadow.
A five-colour band, 6px tall, fixed at the top of every page.

rules.name: The Colour-Means-Region Rule
rules.body: A line colour on a map, chip or tile identifies a region or a tool category. Do not use a line colour as decoration.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Orange with ink text is the primary search action and the "next stop" announcement. Every other button is ink.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange never carries white text; --mt-on-orange is ink in both themes.

rules.name: The Heavy Name Rule
rules.body: Names, headings and values are 800 or 900. Do not set a heading in a light or regular weight.

rules.name: The Signage Floor Rule
rules.body: Text is 11px or larger. Small captions stay in ink-2 or on-board-2, never lighter.

rules.name: The Flat-On-The-Ground Rule
rules.body: Containers sit on the ground with an outline, not a shadow. A shadow appears only on something that floats over content (menu, map popup).

dos: Do keep one ground and one ink; draw containers with 2px ink outlines and no resting shadow.
Do use a line colour only for its region, or for the tool category it already marks, and pair it with its --mt-on-* text colour.
Do make the primary search action orange with ink text; make every other primary button ink.
Do set names and headings at weight 800-900 in UniWay Sign, 11px minimum anywhere.
Do draw state: solid for open, dot for some, hollow for none, and state the same fact in text.
Do reference --mt-* tokens in new rules and test both data-theme values.
Do keep the 3px focus outline on every interactive element.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass, blur or backdrop-filter; they were removed deliberately and background-image: none is enforced on buttons.
Don't put a line colour behind white text if it fails contrast: orange takes ink text; use red-text and blue-text for small red or blue text.
Don't add new line colours or recolour a region; an extra hue breaks the map's meaning.
Don't write new rules against --uw-* or --glass-*; they exist only for old stylesheets.
Don't put a label above a heading. Kicker and eyebrow elements are hidden by the build; do not reintroduce them.
Don't add pastel fills, shadowed floating cards or arcs and halos to maps.
